articles.title_en: Inclusive refugee-hosting can improve local development and prevent public backlash
articles.title_cn: 包容性难民收容可促进当地发展并防止公众反弹
articles.abstract_en: Large arrivals of refugees raise concerns about potential tensions with host communities, particularly if refugees are viewed as an out-group competing for limited material resources and crowding out public services. To address these concerns, calls have increased to allocate humanitarian aid in ways that also benefit host communities. This study tests whether the increased presence of refugees, when coupled with humanitarian aid, improves public service delivery for host communities and dampens potential social conflict. We study this question in Uganda, one of the largest and most inclusive refugee-hosting countries. The data combines geospatial information on refugee settlements with original longitudinal data on primary and secondary schools, road density, health clinics, and health utilization. We report two key findings. First, even after the 2014 arrival of over 1 million South Sudanese refugees, host communities with greater refugee presence experienced substantial improvements in local development. Second, using public opinion data, we find no evidence that refugee presence has been associated with more negative (or positive) attitudes towards migrants or migration policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 大量难民涌入引发了对与收容社区潜在紧张关系的担忧，特别是当难民被视为争夺有限物质资源并排挤公共服务的群体时。为应对这些担忧，越来越多的人呼吁以同样惠及收容社区的方式分配人道主义援助。本研究检验了难民存在增加，当与人道主义援助相结合时，是否改善了收容社区的公共服务提供并抑制了潜在的社会冲突。我们在乌干达（最大的、最具包容性的难民收容国之一）研究这一问题。数据将难民定居点的地理空间信息与小学和中学、道路密度、卫生诊所和卫生服务利用的原始纵向数据相结合。我们报告两个关键发现。首先，即使在2014年超过1万南苏丹难民抵达后，难民存在较多的收容社区也经历了当地发展的实质性改善。其次，利用民意调查数据，我们没有发现难民存在与对移民或移民政策更负面（或正面）态度相关的证据。

articles.title_en: Allocation of humanitarian aid after a weather disaster
articles.title_cn: 天气灾害后的人道主义援助分配
articles.abstract_en: This paper tests whether need or political economy factors determine the allocation of humanitarian aid in the wake of the 2015/16 winter disaster in Mongolia. The identification strategy exploits the exogenous nature of the extremely cold, snowy winter and its spatial variation across Mongolia as well as the fact that the Government defined clear criteria of need across districts based on meteorological risk projections. Using rich district-level data, we distinguish between humanitarian aid delivered by the Mongolian Government and by international donors at the extensive margin (whether a district received any aid) and intensive margin (targeted households per district). Results show that projected need is the strongest predictor for the allocation of international humanitarian aid across districts. Projected need is less relevant for the allocation of governmental humanitarian aid. We do not find evidence that political alignment or core voter considerations matter for either governmental or international humanitarian aid in this young democracy.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文检验了在蒙古2015/16年冬季灾害后，需求还是政治经济因素决定了人道主义援助的分配。识别策略利用了极端寒冷、多雪的冬季的外生性质及其在蒙古的空间变化，以及政府根据气象风险预测在地区间明确界定了需求标准这一事实。利用丰富的地区级数据，我们在广泛边际（地区是否获得任何援助）和密集边际（每个地区目标家庭数）上区分了蒙古政府提供的和国际捐助者提供的人道主义援助。结果表明，预测需求是国际人道主义援助在地区间分配的最强预测因子。预测需求对政府人道主义援助的分配相关性较小。我们没有发现证据表明政治结盟或核心选民考虑因素在这个年轻民主国家中对政府或国际人道主义援助有影响。

articles.title_en: Clientelistic politics and pro-poor targeting: Rules versus discretionary budgets
articles.title_cn: 依附政治和扶贫目标：规则与可自由支配的预算
articles.abstract_en: Past research has provided evidence of clientelistic politics by local governments in delivery of private good benefits and manipulation of local budgets by elected officials at upper tiers. Using household panel survey data spanning 1998–2008 in West Bengal, India, we examine the consequences of replacing the observed allocation of local government, or gram panchayat (GP), program budgets based on discretion of higher level officials, with a grant allocation determined by a formula recommended by the 3rd West Bengal State Finance Commission (SFC) based on measures of village need. We assume that the allocation of benefits within GPs continues to be delegated to elected GP officials. We use the household data to classify them as ultra-poor, moderately poor, marginally poor, and non-poor respectively, depending on the number of deprivation dimensions applicable (landlessness, illiteracy and low caste status). In the next step, we estimate within-GP targeting patterns for different programs across these four groups, and how they are affected by the program grant received by the GP from upper tiers. This allows us to predict how targeting patterns would have changed, had the observed across-GP grant allocations been replaced by the formula-based allocation. We find that targeting of anti-poverty programs was progressive both within and across GPs while the targeting of public goods was not. This pattern is consistent with clientelistic opportunism of upper level officials. The SFC-rule based formula resulted in allocations that were less progressive than the observed allocation. Moreover, alternative formulae for across-GP budgets obtained by varying weights on GP characteristics used in the formula would have marginally improved pro-poor targeting. Hence, it is unlikely that switching to SFC formula-based grants would have improved pro-poor targeting.
articles.abstract_cn: 过去的研究提供了地方政府为私人利益提供庇护政治以及上层民选官员操纵地方预算的证据。我们利用印度西孟加拉邦 1998-2008 的家庭小组调查数据，研究了用由 3 西孟加拉邦财政委员会 (SFC) 根据村庄需求衡量标准推荐的公式确定的赠款分配取代观察到的地方政府或 gram panchayat (GP) 项目预算分配的后果。我们假设全科医生内部的福利分配继续委托给当选的全科医生官员。我们根据适用的贫困维度（无土地、文盲和低种姓地位）的数量，使用家庭数据将他们分别分类为超贫困、中度贫困、边缘贫困和非贫困。在下一步中，我们估计这四个群体中不同计划的 GP 内部目标模式，以及它们如何受到 GP 从上层收到的计划拨款的影响。这使我们能够预测，如果观察到的跨 GP 拨款分配被基于公式的分配所取代，目标模式将如何变化。我们发现，针对反贫困计划的目标在全科医生内部和跨全科医生之间都是进步的，而针对公共产品的目标则不然。这种模式与上层官员的依附投机主义是一致的。基于证监会规则的公式导致分配的累进性低于观察到的分配。此外，通过改变公式中所用的普通人特征的权重而获得的跨普通人预算的替代公式将略微改善扶贫目标。因此，改用证监会基于公式的赠款不太可能改善扶贫目标。

articles.title_en: Designing feasible anti-corruption strategies in the Nigerian health system: A latent class analysis of a discrete choice experiment
articles.title_cn: 设计尼日利亚卫生系统中可行的反腐败策略：一项离散选择实验的潜在类别分析
articles.abstract_en: Health worker absenteeism is a major form of corruption in the Nigerian health system, reducing the impact of healthcare investment and disproportionately affecting vulnerable communities. Top-down governance and accountability measures to improve attendance have had limited effect, potentially because they have not addressed underlying incentives driving health worker behaviour. To inform feasible interventions to reduce absenteeism, we sought to investigate how potential interventions targeting key drivers of absenteeism could influence behaviour through a discrete choice experiment with 412 primary health care workers in Enugu State, Nigeria. The experiment included six attributes drawing on a literature review, qualitative research and stakeholder consultation: facility relationship with the community, method of supervision, attendance-related rewards or punishments, flexible working policy, posting location and financial incentives. Respondent choices were analysed with mixed multinomial logistic and latent class models and used to simulate job uptake under different policies. We found all attributes significantly influenced choices: workers strongly preferred jobs that facilitated supportive community relationships (β = 0.37), had a financial incentive worth 10 % of a worker’s salary (β = 0.39), rewarded attendance with credit towards promotion (β = 0.25) or placement in training (β = 0.14), and offered flexible work conditions (β = 0.14). Using latent class analysis, we identified two sub-groups of workers who differed in their willingness to accept a job and preferences over specific attributes, suggesting some may be more susceptible to feasible interventions to improve attendance. We argue that focusing on the needs of these groups may offer a path to incrementally, but sustainably, reduce absenteeism across the system. Our findings build on frameworks developed in anti-corruption research in other sectors only recently been applied to the health sector. The work represents some of the only empirical evidence to inform anti-corruption strategies in Nigeria and internationally, with findings relevant to other low- and middle-income countries seeking to combat absenteeism among primary health care workers.
articles.abstract_cn: 卫生工作者缺勤是尼日利亚卫生系统中腐败的一种主要形式，削弱了医疗投资的影响，并对弱势社区造成不成比例的伤害。旨在改善出勤率的自上而下的治理和问责措施效果有限，可能是因为这些措施未解决驱动卫生工作者行为的潜在激励。为制定可行的干预措施以减少缺勤，我们通过一项离散选择实验，调查了针对缺勤关键驱动因素的潜在干预措施如何影响行为，实验对象为尼日利亚埃努古州的412名初级卫生保健工作者。实验包含六个属性，这些属性基于文献综述、定性研究和利益相关者咨询：设施与社区的关系、监督方式、与出勤相关的奖惩、灵活工作政策、派驻地点和经济激励。受访者的选择通过混合多项逻辑模型和潜在类别模型进行分析，并用于模拟不同政策下的工作接受情况。我们发现所有属性均显著影响选择：工作者强烈偏好有助于支持性社区关系的工作（β = 0.37）、相当于工资10%的经济激励（β = 0.39）、以晋升学分（β = 0.25）或培训名额（β = 0.14）奖励出勤的工作，以及提供灵活工作条件的工作（β = 0.14）。通过潜在类别分析，我们识别出两个工作者亚组，他们在接受工作的意愿和对特定属性的偏好上存在差异，表明某些群体可能更容易受到改善出勤率的可行干预措施的影响。我们认为，关注这些群体的需求可能为逐步但可持续地减少整个系统的缺勤提供途径。我们的发现建立在其他部门反腐败研究中开发的框架之上，这些框架最近才应用于卫生部门。这项工作是为尼日利亚和国际上提供反腐败策略实证证据的少数研究之一，其发现对寻求解决初级卫生保健工作者缺勤问题的其他低收入和中等收入国家具有相关性。

articles.title_en: Sobriety, social capital, and village network structures
articles.title_cn: 戒酒、社会资本与村庄网络结构
articles.abstract_en: External shocks or stimuli can have significant effects on community network structures, which in turn can affect relationship ties and social capital. To this point, however, few studies analyze impacts of self-help programs, such as those targeting substance abuse, on network structures or measures of social capital. This study analyzes the effects of a randomized control trial (RCT) in western Kenya that included an intervention aimed at decreasing alcohol abuse using group therapies and spousal level counseling. Using dyadic network data collected from alcohol-using households, the analysis finds that two nearby same-gender peers randomly assigned to the treatment group are 9 percentage points [pp] more likely to have an agricultural information link with their peer and 8 pp more likely to work with their peer compared to two individuals in the control group. Additional individual-level results find that assignment to the treatment significantly increases an individual’s network centrality as measured by degree, closeness, and betweenness. I explore potential mechanisms and find evidence suggesting network effects at the intensive and extensive margin and the development of support linkages all likely contributed to these results. This study shows that programs utilizing peer effects can not only have positive impacts on alcohol consumption, but also positive spillover effects on relationship ties and on a treated individual’s network centrality. The results thus suggest significant positive impacts of the program on social capital, and points to the indirect benefits of substance abuse programs (and self-help programs in general) on communities.
articles.abstract_cn: 外部冲击或刺激可能对社区网络结构产生显著影响，进而影响关系纽带和社会资本。然而，迄今为止，很少有研究分析自助项目（如针对药物滥用的项目）对网络结构或社会资本衡量指标的影响。本研究分析了在肯尼亚西部进行的一项随机对照试验（RCT）的效果，该试验包含一项旨在通过团体治疗和配偶层面咨询减少酒精滥用的干预措施。利用从饮酒家庭收集的二元网络数据，分析发现，与对照组中的两个个体相比，随机分配到治疗组的两个邻近同性同伴之间建立农业信息联系的可能性高出9个百分点，与同伴合作的可能性高出8个百分点。额外的个体层面结果发现，分配到治疗组显著提高了个体的网络中心性，以度数中心性、接近中心性和中介中心性衡量。我探讨了潜在机制，并发现证据表明，集约边际和广延边际的网络效应以及支持联系的发展都可能促成了这些结果。本研究表明，利用同伴效应的项目不仅能对酒精消费产生积极影响，还能对关系纽带和受治疗个体的网络中心性产生积极的溢出效应。因此，结果表明该项目对社会资本产生了显著的积极影响，并指出了药物滥用项目（以及一般的自助项目）对社区的间接益处。

articles.title_en: Has Chinese aid benefited recipient countries? Evidence from a meta-regression analysis
articles.title_cn: 中国援助是否惠及受援国？来自元回归分析的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper employs a meta-regression analysis of 1,149 estimates from 29 studies to take stock of the empirical literature on Chinese aid effectiveness. After accommodating publication selection bias, we find that, on average, Beijing’s foreign assistance is positively associated with economic outcomes in recipient countries, but correlates with deforestation and negative perceptions of China among citizens, albeit negligible in size. We also show that studies that fail to uncover empirical effects that conform to researchers’ expectations are less likely to be submitted or accepted for publication. Differences in the choice of data, estimation method, and authors’ institutional affiliation explain the heterogeneity among Chinese aid effectiveness estimates reported in the literature.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过对29项研究的1,149个估计值进行元回归分析，总结了关于中国援助有效性的实证文献。在考虑了出版选择偏差后，我们发现，平均而言，北京的对外援助与受援国的经济成果正相关，但与森林砍伐和公民对中国的负面看法相关，尽管影响规模很小。我们还表明，未能发现符合研究者预期的实证效果的研究更不可能被提交或接受发表。数据选择、估计方法和作者机构隶属关系的差异解释了文献中报告的中国援助有效性估计值之间的异质性。

articles.title_en: Explaining the development policy implementation gap: A case of a failed food sovereignty policy in Bolivia
articles.title_cn: 解释发展政策实施差距：玻利维亚一项失败的食物主权政策案例
articles.abstract_en: The food sovereignty concept has gained prominence in public policy discourses in the global South during the last decades. However, food sovereignty has contested definitions and is interpreted differently by conflicting societal interests. Consequentially, the translation of food sovereignty concepts into concrete policies and practices is often characterized by conflicts and controversies rooted in different institutional logics guiding the involved actors. In this article, we analyse how the logics of the corporatized agro-food system affected the local implementation of top-down state-induced public food sovereignty-based policies in Bolivia. We conducted a multiple-case study of public food procurement markets for school feeding programs involving three rural municipalities and small-scale producers in the Altiplano region. The data consists of 53 interviews conducted during 2011–2015. We found that corporate food regime logics influence the local policy implementation process in three ways. First, by framing the chosen policy design as neoliberal individualistic and transaction-based market-orientated. Second, by envisioning for the Aymara subsistence peasants a socially and culturally undesirable identity and class transformation; and thirdly, indirectly through the dependency of the school feed program on adjacent field-level institutions shaped by the corporate food regime logics. We conclude that the corporate food regime logics shaped the notion of what was considered legitimate practices and processes required for smallholders to access the public food procurement market, whereas their own conceptions aligned with food sovereignty principles were disregarded.
articles.abstract_cn: 近几十年来，食物主权概念在全球南方的公共政策话语中日益突出。然而，食物主权存在争议性的定义，且被相互冲突的社会利益群体以不同方式解读。因此，食物主权概念转化为具体政策和实践的过程，往往以冲突和争议为特征，这些冲突根植于指导相关行动者的不同制度逻辑。在本文中，我们分析了企业化农业食品系统的逻辑如何影响玻利维亚自上而下的国家主导的基于食物主权的公共政策的地方实施。我们对阿尔蒂普拉诺地区三个农村市镇和小规模生产者的学校供餐计划公共食品采购市场进行了多案例研究。数据包括2011-2015年间进行的53次访谈。我们发现，企业食品体制逻辑以三种方式影响地方政策实施过程。第一，通过将所选政策设计框定为新自由主义个人主义和基于交易的市场导向；第二，通过设想艾马拉自给农民经历社会和文化的不可取身份和阶级转变；第三，间接通过学校供餐计划对受企业食品体制逻辑影响的邻近田间层面机构的依赖。我们得出结论，企业食品体制逻辑塑造了被认为小农进入公共食品采购市场所需的合法实践和过程的观念，而他们自身与食物主权原则一致的概念则被忽视。

articles.title_en: Entrepreneurship for all? The rise of a global “entrepreneurship for development” agenda, 1950–2021
articles.title_cn: 人人创业？全球“创业促发展”议程的兴起，1950-2021
articles.abstract_en: This article provides a macro-sociological analysis of the rise and transformation of entrepreneurship as an ideology in international development discourse over time. Drawing upon over 5,000 documents produced by UNESCO and the World Bank from 1950 to 2021, this article examines how dominant ideas around applications and purposes of entrepreneurship, as well as the role of the entrepreneur, in international development discourse evolved over time. The article illustrates that entrepreneurship in international development discourse underwent a shift from the 1950s to the 2010s, with a marked change occurring around the turn of the twenty-first century. It argues that the role and purposes of entrepreneurship become increasingly expanded over time to be viewed as a solution that can address the world’s social, economic, cultural, and environmental challenges. It further asserts that entrepreneurship, influenced by world cultural norms of empowered individualism and agency, becomes perceived as something that any individual can engage in as long as they have the motivation, drive, and vision to do so. The idealized image and purpose of the entrepreneur by the twenty-first century is no longer someone motivated by economic gain; instead, the ideal entrepreneur is inspired by a desire to influence change in the world toward development and progress.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文对国际发展话语中创业作为一种意识形态的兴起与转变进行了宏观社会学分析。基于联合国教科文组织和世界银行在1950年至2021年间产生的超过5,000份文件，本文考察了国际发展话语中关于创业应用与目的以及企业家角色的主流观念如何随时间演变。文章表明，国际发展话语中的创业在1950年至2010年间经历了转变，并在二十一世纪之交发生了显著变化。文章认为，创业的角色和目的随时间不断扩展，逐渐被视为能够解决世界社会、经济、文化和环境挑战的方案。文章进一步断言，受赋权个人主义和能动性的世界文化规范影响，创业被视为任何个体只要具备动机、驱动力和愿景即可参与的活动。到二十一世纪，企业家的理想形象和目的不再是受经济收益驱动；相反，理想的企业家受到影响世界向发展和进步变革的愿望所激励。
